description: Source code for ElementHandleDispatcher class in Playwright, handling DOM element interactions and dispatching methods for browser automation.

classes.name: ElementHandleDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for DOM element handles, providing methods to interact with and query DOM elements in browser automation.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an ElementHandleDispatcher for a given ElementHandle within a scope.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an ElementHandleDispatcher if handle is not null.

methods.name: fromJSOrElementHandle
methods.description: Creates a dispatcher from a JSHandle, returning an ElementHandleDispatcher if possible.

methods.name: ownerFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the owner frame of the element handle.

methods.name: contentFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the content frame of the element handle.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Gets the value of an attribute of the element.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current input value of the element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Gets the text content of the element.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Gets the inner text of the element.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Gets the inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if the element is checked (for checkboxes/radios).

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if the element is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is enabled.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if the element is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the element is visible.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event on the element.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the element into view if needed.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over the element.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks the element.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Double-clicks the element.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Taps the element.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options within a select element.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the element with a value.

methods.name: selectText
methods.description: Selects text within the element.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets input files for file input elements.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the element.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the element.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Presses a key on the element.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks a checkbox or radio button.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks a checkbox.

methods.name: boundingBox
methods.description: Gets the bounding box of the element.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the element.

methods.name: querySelector
methods.description: Queries a child element matching a selector.

methods.name: querySelectorAll
methods.description: Queries all child elements matching a selector.

methods.name: evalOnSelector
methods.description: Evaluates a function on a selector.

methods.name: evalOnSelectorAll
methods.description: Evaluates a function on all matching selectors.

methods.description: Waits for an element to reach a specific state.
